title: I built a 3D coin pusher that Twitch chat plays in the browser
author: revyxrevyx
selftext:
Made with Cusror 

\- Grok 4.6 high, ThreeJS, Supabase, Twitch api.



StreamChatPlay is a real 3D coin pusher. The whole game runs in your browser: open a tab, capture it in OBS. Viewers stay in Twitch chat. They type, a coin drops with their name and avatar, physics does the rest. Front pit = points. Sides = gone. Nothing to download.

How viewers play:

\- Any chat message drops a coin (if they have coins in their wallet)  
\- A lone number like 5 drops that many, up to your cap  
\- !coins / !points / !day / !hour / !week for balances and boards  
\- !dice spends 10 coins and rolls two dice on the table  
\- Regulars can pick a name-plate look on the viewer page  
\- Lot of mini games coming (try !head / !tails or !plinko)

How you run it:

1. [https://www.streamchatplay.com](https://www.streamchatplay.com/)
2. Connect the Twitch account whose chat should play
3. Open Coin Pusher, click Launch
4. OBS: Window Capture that Chrome tab, or one Browser Source on the game URL — not both
5. Press H to hide the HUD
6. Wallets, points, and your settings are saved per channel in the cloud, not only in that browser.

It’s early. Billing is not open. Testers stay on a free trial. Coin Pusher is the first game; more are planned. Physics runs on your PC, so a busy chat can eat FPS — you can cap how many chat coins sit on the table.

check who is running it: [https://www.streamchatplay.com/watch/](https://www.streamchatplay.com/watch/)  


If you try it, I’d love your feedback. Happy to answer setup questions in the comments.
